about-us.title: About Universe
about-us.content:
Universe brings campus life together: discover events, meet student clubs and societies, find opportunities, and explore spaces at Deree.

Find your place on campus

Browse events by interest, explore creator profiles, or catch up with campus news. An attendee account lets you use the portal’s participation features, follow creators, and save events.

Tools for student creators

Clubs and organizations can create a profile, publish activities and announcements, and share opportunities with their community. Register as a creator to get started.

Explore more of the community

Find opportunities, browse campus venues, explore athletic facilities, and connect through community posts and chat.

About this demonstration

This installation is a campus-community demonstration. Organization and venue facts draw on official ACG sources. Student accounts, participation, messages, applications, and reservations are fictional demo activity. The portal does not replace official College services or confirm real-world bookings.

Need a hand?

Visit the Help Center for step-by-step answers or see Contact for available support channels.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.content:
This page explains the information used by this Universe demonstration and the choices available in the portal.

Account information

Registration collects the fields shown on the attendee or creator form, including names, a username, email address, and any requested student or organization details. Passwords are stored as hashes. Keep your sign-in details private and avoid entering sensitive information into this demo.

Activity and visibility

Creator profiles, published events, announcements, and public community posts can be viewed by other visitors. Participation, follows, favorites, applications, reservations, and comments are stored to support portal features. Review your account and profile settings before sharing information.

Messages and uploaded files

Chat access is restricted to conversation participants. Uploaded application documents and other private files use access checks. Public posts and profile images are visible where published. Do not use demonstration accounts or conversations for confidential communication.

Browser storage and third-party services

Session cookies support authentication. The cookie-notice choice is saved in browser storage. The site includes Google Analytics; embedded media, maps, and sharing tools may contact their providers when used. Those providers handle requests under their own policies. See the Cookie policy for more detail.

Demo records and support requests

The preloaded student accounts and interactions are fictional. Public organization facts are based on ACG references. Email and SMS delivery in demo mode is captured for testing instead of being sent to real recipients. Messages submitted through any enabled contact form are handled by the portal’s configured delivery system.

Your choices

Use the account settings available to your role to review profile details and visibility. You can clear cookies and local storage through your browser, which may sign you out. For questions about data stored in this installation, use the channels listed on Contact. No automatic deletion or retention period is promised by this demo.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie policy
cookie-policy.content:
Universe uses cookies and browser storage to keep its account features working and remember the cookie-notice choice.

Session and sign-in cookies

The application uses a session cookie to associate requests with your visit and support signed-in actions. Choosing “Remember me” on sign-in can also create a persistent authentication cookie. Blocking these cookies can prevent account features from working.

Notice preference

When you dismiss the cookie notice, the site saves a cookiesAccepted value in your browser’s local storage. Local storage is separate from cookies. This choice dismisses the notice; it is not a granular preference control for analytics or external services.

Analytics and external content

This installation includes Google Analytics. Embedded videos, maps, and social sharing tools can send requests to their providers and may use their own cookies or storage. Provider behavior depends on the content you open and your browser settings.

Manage browser storage

Your browser settings let you inspect, block, and delete cookies and clear site storage. Clearing authentication cookies can sign you out. Clearing the notice preference makes the notice appear again.

Questions

Read the Privacy policy or visit Contact for the support channels configured for this installation.

legal-notice.title: Terms of service
legal-notice.content:
These terms describe the intended use and limits of this Universe campus-community demonstration.

Demonstration scope

This installation demonstrates event discovery, creator profiles, community interactions, opportunities, and facility reservations. Preloaded student accounts and activity are fictional. Organization and venue information draws on public ACG references; inclusion does not establish College endorsement.

Accounts and participation

Use accurate information for any account you create, keep your credentials private, and use only accounts and functions you are authorized to access. Attendee and creator accounts have different permissions. Do not impersonate another person or organization.

Community conduct

Keep posts, messages, comments, and uploads relevant and respectful. Do not share confidential information, harass others, distribute unlawful content, or upload material you do not have permission to use. Creators are responsible for the information they publish.

Events, opportunities, and reservations

Demo participation, applications, tickets, and bookings do not confirm real-world attendance, employment, access, or facility availability. Verify actual activities and requirements with the organizer or the relevant College service before making plans.

Availability and external links

Demo features and records can change as the project is maintained. External websites, media, and services operate independently. Check their information and terms directly.

Privacy and questions

See the Privacy policy and Cookie policy for how this installation uses information and browser storage. Visit the Help Center for product help or Contact for available support channels.
